description:
"Stir a group of shalk that attack after |cffffff3|r seconds, dealing |cffffff9521|r Magic Damage to enemies in front of you.

After the shalk complete their attack, they burrow underground for |cffffff6|r seconds and then resurface again, dealing |cffffff13224|r Magic Damage to enemies in front of you.

Enemies damaged are afflicted with Major and Minor Breach, reducing their Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff5948|r and |cffffff2974|r for |cffffff10|r seconds."
